verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-export feature, such as a full-account export or CSV/XLS/JSON export of records or reports. It also has no documented offboarding or data-portability path. The REST API's stated parity with the web client is only a developer building block from which a user could build their own export, so it earns no credit under the partial-credit rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
